Theme version 1.0.0

Home/Templates/Templates

Templates

Templates

A template decides which sections a kind of page starts with. Hale & Okafor has a template for every page type Shopify requires, plus alternate templates for lots, editions, commissions, the archive and the studio pages.

To give a product, collection or page an alternate template, open it in the Shopify admin and choose the template under Theme template. To edit a template, pick it from the page list at the top of the theme editor.
